high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job is designed to compile a batch COBOL program within an IBM mainframe environment. It uses a parameterized approach, allowing users to substitute the placeholder program name **BATCHPGM** with their actual program name, and references a high-level qualifier (HLQ) of **AWS.M2** to locate necessary libraries and procedures. The job invokes the **BUILDBAT** procedure from a utility procedure library to perform the compilation, producing an executable batch program ready for deployment.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The accounting information and job name identifier. The string 'Compile Batch COBOL Program' serves as the programmer name or accounting information associated with the job.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is assigned. CLASS=A routes the job to job class A, which determines scheduling priority and resource allocation based on installation-defined class definitions.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (system messages). MSGCLASS=H routes the job's message output to output class H, which determines how and where the job log is printed or held.

parameters.name: MSGLEVEL
parameters.description: Controls the level of JCL and system messages printed in the job log. The first value (1) prints all JCL statements including those from procedures; the second value (1) prints all system messages including those for non-abnormal terminations.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of memory the job can use. REGION=0M allows the job to use the maximum available region size, effectively removing memory constraints on the job.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the user ID to be notified when the job completes. &SYSUID is a symbolic parameter that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, sending a completion notification message to that user.

parameters.name: TIME
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum CPU time allowed for the entire job in minutes. TIME=1440 sets the limit to 1440 minutes (24 hours), effectively allowing the job to run without a practical CPU time restriction.

job_details.purpose: Compiles the COBOL source program specified by the MEMNAME symbolic variable (BATCHPGM) using the IBM COBOL compiler IGYCRCTL. The compiler options APOST, LIST, MAP, NUMBER, and NOSEQ are applied, and the resulting object code is passed to a temporary dataset for subsequent link-editing.
job_details.inputs: SYSIN: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL(BATCHPGM) (COBOL source), SYSLIB: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY (copybooks), CEE.SCEESAMP (Language Environment samples)
job_details.outputs: SYSPRINT: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LST(BATCHPGM) (compiler listing), SYSLIN: &&LOADSET (temporary object deck passed to linker), SYSUT1-SYSUT15 and SYSMDECK: temporary work datasets on 3390

job_details.purpose: Copies the compiler listing from the partitioned dataset member to SYSOUT using the IBM utility IEBGENER, making the compiler output available in the job log for review.
job_details.outputs: SYSUT2: SYSOUT=* (compiler listing printed to job output)

job_details.purpose: Link-edits the compiled object deck produced by the COMPILE step into an executable load module using the IBM Linkage Editor HEWL, with LIST and XREF options. This step is skipped if the COMPILE step returned a condition code of 8 or higher.
job_details.inputs: SYSLIN: &&LOADSET (object deck from COMPILE step), SYSLIB: SYS1.LINKLIB, CSF.SCSFMOD0, CEE.SCEELKED, CEE.SCEELKEX, AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB (link-edit libraries)
job_details.outputs: SYSLMOD: AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB(BATCHPGM) (executable load module), SYSPRINT: SYSOUT=* (link-edit map and cross-reference listing), SYSUT1: temporary work dataset on 3390
